objective: Separate product release-blocking scientific evidence from claim-specific historical external reproduction evidence without weakening fail-closed validation.
previous_knowledge_consumed: Frozen historical-reference architecture and P0 completion record.
Scientific validation policy distinguishing product validation from external reproduction claims.

baseline.description: The release gate aggregated product and external reproduction blockers into one overall release-blocking status.

expected_improvement: External historical reconstruction remains explicit and auditable but does not block a product release unless that claim is part of the declared release scope.
Product-scope scientific checks remain fully release-blocking.

validation.evidence: Regression test locks the separation of product and external gate scope.

failure_analysis.root_cause: evaluate_release_gate aggregated external reproduction blockers into the overall product gate and marked external_reproduction release_blocking=true.
failure_analysis.resolution: Product gate now derives only from product blockers; external blockers remain separately reported.

findings: Release-blocking scope must follow the declared product claim, not every optional historical reproduction claim.
External reproduction remains fail-closed and visible as claim-specific evidence.

knowledge_carried_forward: Do not weaken product scientific checks to accommodate unresolved external reproduction.
Do not present unresolved historical reconstruction as product failure when the release does not claim exact reconstruction.
